peerGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (OCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

positions.label: Price position
positions.statement: Price position — In line with comparable condos: 1.5% below its local comparables; 52 of 102 similar developments with a figure have a lower relative price (a position, not a measure of value).

positions.label: Resale activity
positions.statement: Resale activity — Above peers (96.3): 7 resales per 100 homes a year (24 months): higher than 104 of 108 similar developments with a figure. Context, not scored: resales in 100% of months (24 months).

comparisonGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (OCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

profile.rule: Each line compares this development with its own comparison group; numbers from different groups are not comparable. There is no overall score.
profile.surroundingMarket: Surrounding market: other condo and EC developments within 2 km (straight line between development positions); new sales plus resales; subsales, cluster and other landed housing, HDB flats and this development are excluded. Competition, the quiet-area check and the Market backdrop use this same set.

lines.label: Entry price against comparable developments
lines.statement: 1-bedroom: median $800,000 ($1,633 psf, 430–505 sq ft; 11 resales, Oct 2025–Sep 2026); 5 comparable developments within 5 km: median $1,703 psf (range $1,492–1,868); 4.1% below; illustrative entry-price difference about $34,000 less. 2-bedroom: median $1,105,000 ($1,666 psf, 581–785 sq ft; 18 resales, Oct 2025–Sep 2026); 6 comparable developments within 3 km: median $1,650 psf (range $1,417–1,732); 1% above; illustrative entry-price difference about $11,000 more. The entry-price difference is illustrative: the median price adjusted to the comparable median psf, for a similar-size unit. A premium or a discount is not in itself an advantage or a disadvantage.

lines.label: Sustained resale activity
lines.statement: The first resale wave ended before the observation period: sustained activity is the observed activity. First resale wave from Jun 2023 (analytical proxy: the month recorded resales first reach 2% of homes; not an official MOP date); 14 earlier resales do not start the wave.

wave.basisLabel: analytical proxy: the month recorded resales first reach 2% of homes; not an official MOP date

lines.label: MRT today
lines.statement: Thanggam LRT about 90 m, Kupang LRT about 650 m; closer than 111 of 116 similar developments. Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Primary schools
lines.statement: 3 within 1 km and 6 within 2 km; nearest Fern Green Primary School about 570 m; more than 75 of 116 similar developments (the same as 10). Straight-line distances. MOE measures distance for school admission differently.

lines.label: Everyday amenities
lines.statement: 4 supermarkets within 1 km (nearest about 310 m), more than 54 of 116 similar developments (the same as 26); nearest hawker centre Fernvale Hawker Centre & Market about 720 m; nearest park Fernvale Park about 40 m. Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Future transport
lines.statement: Not yet assessed: needs official LTA evidence for planned stations.

lines.label: Recorded new-launch competition
lines.statement: No other condo development sold new homes within 2 km. Surrounding market, Oct 2025–Sep 2026: 14 other condo and EC developments within 2 km recorded 0 new sales and 408 resales (408 purchases); new sales were 0% of these purchases. Subsales (0) and this development’s own transactions are excluded. New sales as a share of local private purchases is a measure of market activity, not of supply pressure.

lines.label: Unsold inventory

missing.reason: not available until the URA-based launched-unsold measure (S3) passes the V1 local validation; no other inventory source is used

lines.statement: Not available: unsold inventory has not been validated.

lines.label: Known pipeline

missing.reason: known sites only; not a complete pipeline

lines.statement: No site within 2 km in the known list. Known sites only; not a complete pipeline.

lines.label: Quiet-area check
lines.statement: Not a quiet area. 408 resales within 2 km in Oct 2025–Sep 2026, more than 53 of 116 similar developments.

lines.label: Market backdrop
lines.statement: Condo and EC resales within 2 km: 408 in Oct 2025–Sep 2026 against 392 in Oct 2024–Sep 2025 (+4.1%). Planning-area private resales −10%. Observed transactions, not a prediction.
